title: Chapter 2 · Bernat at El Nucli and his model of the flat
description: After the Queen took Aitor, Bernat calls them to El Nucli: on his table stands a model of the Meridiana flat, the real one built small. At his table he says they are inside a game, and the three of them look at the camera. Leaning over the model, the camera looks down at it from above and Bernat's bulb goes off; over it, his sheet: no words, each lamp drawn as its name (the moon a moon, the table a table, the kitchen a pot, the sofa a sofa), + − = and a question mark on the moon. The model, and the real bulbs, show the colours of the sum's lamps; Gerard picks a lamp on the model and changes its colour, and once the moon holds one five seconds every lamp blinks green or red. After the four sums every lamp goes off but the bedroom's, pink, and the artilugio wakes.

steps.caption: El Nucli's back room: Bernat at his table, and on it a model of the Meridiana flat (his figure is a stand-in until his own)

steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.gerard.game.world(5.5, 3.5); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: .85, z: p.z }, 1.1); })()

steps.caption: The model on the round table: the flat's own builder at 1/22, its lamps lit as the flat's are
The fourth wall: the three of them look at the camera

steps.eval: window.lamp = (id, type = 'pointerdown', button = 0) => { const p = window.gerard.game.maqueta.screen(id), c = document.querySelector('#game').getBoundingClientRect(); document.querySelector('#portal-box').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { clientX: c.left + p.x, clientY: c.top + p.y, button, bubbles: true })); }; import('/src/friends/bernat.ts').then(b => { window.bernatLamps = b.LAMPS; }) && undefined

steps.caption: Over the model, from above: his sheet, with no words. Each lamp drawn as its name: the moon (?) = the table + the kitchen (a pot). Only the model (and the real bulbs) say what colour each is: the table green, the kitchen blue
A lamp of the sum pressed on the model (the table): its drawing on the sheet stirs; it is not his to change
The pointer over the moon takes it (the ring); one click: red

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const box = document.querySelector('#portal-box'); const check = () => box.dataset.answer === 'wrong' ? setTimeout(done, 80) : requestAnimationFrame(check); check(); })

steps.caption: Held five seconds on the wrong colour: every lamp of the model blinks red, the sheet shakes
Three clicks more round the colours: cyan, held

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const box = document.querySelector('#portal-box'); const check = () => box.dataset.answer === 'right' ? setTimeout(done, 80) : requestAnimationFrame(check); check(); })

steps.caption: Five seconds: every lamp of the model blinks green (the house too, connected), the first dot fills
The second sheet: a subtraction (the moon = the sofa − the table); the model shows the sofa white and the table blue
On the keys: the arrows take the lamps of the model one by one (the ring)
The third: a sum and a subtraction (the table yellow + the kitchen cyan − the sofa green)
The last: the three at once (the table red + the kitchen green + the sofa blue)
Every lamp of the model goes off, one after another
Only the bedroom is left, pink: where the artilugio is, in the real flat
«Ha cruzado. En vuestra habitación. La de verdad.»
